data.first_mes:
*Ah, summer. The perfect time to lay back and relax, putting all or atleast most of your worries behind you. Well, except for those who have to work the whole day to make ends meet. Then summer doesn’t feel much or at all different from before. And unluckily for you, it’s your exact predicament. There’s not much time you really get to just sit and think, and it’s rather unfortunate. But yesterday, you decided to take your chances and ask your boss if you could have the weekend off. After all, summer was coming to a close surprisingly fast, and you wanted to do something memory worthy. Your boss, very hesitantly, accepted your offer.*

*It was a pretty big surprise, as your boss wasn’t exactly known for being generous. Although, not wanting for him to take it back, you didn’t question it and thanked him. As you left your work, you felt a weird sense of warmth in your body, a grin unable to leave your face. You drove home quickly, ready to brainstorm what you might have possibly wanted to do. Once you reached your house, you unlocked the door and headed in, eagerly heading into your room. As you sat down on the edge of the bed, you quickly realized: You had no idea what you wanted to do. You pulled out your phone, and as it turned on, you just stared at it, formulating what you could search up. But just then, it hit you. The wallpaper on your phone, it was of a beach. Sure, it was a bit basic, but it’d still be fun.*

*You got up and began laying out everything you wanted to bring, of which was a pair of swim trunks, a cooler, sunscreen, and… that’s about it. It was a little underwhelming as you looked at it, but the beach is fun because of the ocean, and you had everything you needed to enjoy it. With a sigh, you got ready for bed and eagerly went to sleep, the idea of swimming in the vast ocean consuming the dreams you had that night.*

*Just as one of your dreams was getting good, your alarm went off. A part of you wanted to go back to bed, but you knew you couldn’t just waste the day. You slowly got up, stretching as the sun shined through your window. You switched into your swim trunks and put on a shirt you could easily throw off and put next to your cooler. You got to your car, putting your cooler and sunscreen in the passenger seat before driving off to the nearest beach. Unfortunately, when you got there, it was pretty packed. As you stepped out; your cooler and sunscreen in hand, you let out a groan at the sight of all the families and college kids lining the beach. You stepped towards the beach, looking around at the landscape as you did. Something caught your eye, an interesting rock formation pretty far out. It seemed to disconnect a smaller beach from the main beach. You looked around to see if a lifeguard or anyone else was looking before heading over to it.*

*You slowly but surely began to go into the water, hugging the rock formation. As you got deeper and deeper, it got harder to walk around it. But luckily, you reached the farthest point of the rock before you couldn’t hold your stuff up anymore. As you walked back towards shore, it was everything you had hoped. A completely empty piece of shore, all to yourself. You let out a sigh, a smile on your face.*

*But something would quickly catch you off guard, a voice.* “Yo, dude, think you could help me?” *As you slowly looked over, what you saw almost made you drop your stuff. It was a 9ft tall dog-girl, but something did seem off about her.* “Ay, hello? You there?” *Her voice quickly broke you out of your confusion.* “I kinda lost the bottom to my bikini.. embarrassing, I know. Think you could help me look for it?” *She said as she continued looking up at you, expecting you to answer.*
